title: Dojo
description: The kyu and dan ranks of riichi mahjong scoring. See the whole Road to the black belt in scoring, from 5 Kyu to Shodan (the black belt): for each rank you learn, practice and then pass an exam.
signInNote: You need an account to keep your rank.
journeyTitle: Road to the black belt in scoring
includesDeviceHistory: This includes challenges you finished on this device without logging in.

currentRank.title: Your current rank
currentRank.description: Of the ranks from 5 Kyu to Shodan (the black belt), the ones you have earned are filled in with their belt color. Passing a promotion exam moves you up one.

nextRank.title: The rank you are aiming for
nextRank.description: The rank to work on now. Select the rank name to see its pass criterion and the lessons it builds on.

stages.title: Learn → Practice → Get certified
stages.description: For every rank from 5 Kyu to Shodan (the black belt), you go through these in this order. The numbers show how many of each you have done.

blackBelt.title: What the black belt (Shodan) means
blackBelt.description: It certifies that you can handle riichi mahjong scoring smoothly. Pass the promotion exams in order from 5 Kyu, and at Shodan you earn the black belt.

locked.title: Exams go in order from the lowest rank
locked.description: Ranks are earned in order from the lowest one. You can go ahead with the lessons of higher ranks, but you take the exams in order.

lockedNote: Earn the lower ranks in order to take this exam
examLead: Once you have mastered the lessons this rank builds on, take on the exam.
comingSoon: You have earned every rank available. New ranks are in preparation.

rankDetail.title: {rank} pass criterion
rankDetail.description: {rank} in riichi mahjong scoring. Pass criterion: {criterion}. See the lessons to work through before the exam and what the exam covers.
rankDetail.examLeadWithoutChapters: When you are ready, take on the exam.

practicalTitle: Next, sharpen your skills for real games
practicalDescription: Put the scoring you learned for the black belt to work on real hands. Take on scoring winning hands and tenpai hands.
